request.purpose: List every GW001 Result fixture with no matching Match Report by sm_fixture_id
request.sql: SELECT r.* FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r LEFT JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id WHERE m.sm_fixture_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.competition_key,r.match_date,r.sm_fixture_id
